summary: PASS. F-DG1-134 is verified CLOSED_VERIFIED (fix e71f3d0). walk() now covers every buildable JS/TS extension, and a planted .mts/.mjs/.cts/.cjs/.js/.jsx (and a nested .mts) in a real module directory is flagged for the rule-5 binding and the deep import. The round-12 testkit gave 0 on the same plants. .tsx is parsed as TSX (a require inside JSX text is still caught). The real tree has no non-.ts/.tsx module file and 0 violations. New: F-DG1-135 (Low, non-mandatory, introduced by the fix but not a regression). The lint now treats *.test.mts/.cts/.js/.mjs/.cjs/.jsx as tests, granting the composition-root/vitest import allowance. But the build excludes only *.test.ts/.tsx and vitest runs only *.test.ts, so such a file ships in dist and runs from there. Rules 1-5 still apply to it. All 8 requirements are complete. No Critical/High/mandatory finding is open. Two checks are not PASS, by fact: SEC-R13-03 (FAIL; it found F-DG1-135) and SEC-R13-32c (BLOCKED, no registry).
